reads.evidence: 45 postings for drivers and logistics, the largest family here, then 32 in sales and 29 for technicians.
reads.quality: The work is steady and local, but it is the kind most exposed to automation over the next few years.
reads.move: Track these postings each month. A falling count is the earliest warning the town will get.
reads.why: Title matching is blunt, and the feed undercounts small employers.

reads.need: A long commute for a town with its own jobs
reads.evidence: A mean commute of 29.3 minutes, second only to Inglewood.
reads.quality: Residents are traveling out even though there is work in town, which suggests a mismatch between the jobs here and the people here.
reads.move: Compare where residents work with who fills Gardena's own jobs.
reads.why: Survey averages, and no commuting data pulled yet.

gaps: Casino and card-room hiring, which is mostly not in this feed.
